SELECT
ORGKEY,PREFERREDFLAG,PHONEEMAILTYPE,SCD_START_DATE,SCD_END_DATE,CAST(COALESCE(DATEADD(DAY,-1,END_DATE2),'9999-12-31') AS DATE) SCD_END_DATE2
FROM
(
    SELECT 
    *,
    Max(Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) 
    Over (PARTITION BY ORGKEY, PREFERREDFLAG, PHONEEMAILTYPE, BANK_ID  ORDER BY Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) 
    ROWS BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING AND 1 FOLLOWING) END_DATE2
    FROM
    EDS.CRM_PHONEEMAIL WHERE ORGKEY='R01274190' AND PREFERREDFLAG='Y' AND PHONEEMAILTYPE='HOMEPH1'
) CRM_PHONEEMAIL WHERE SCD_END_DATE <> CAST(COALESCE(DATEADD(DAY,-1,END_DATE2),'9999-12-31') AS DATE)
